change: Global mode becomes the user's system proxy on Windows (WinINet) and Linux (GNOME gsettings); the TUN global, its fail-closed guard and DNS takeover are removed and only legacy cleanup remains. Adds the experimental per-app Windows AppContainer strong isolation (PR #11).
owner_decision: 2026-10-18: after TUN global left the owner's PC without Internet, the owner asked to remove TUN global on Windows and Linux and use an ordinary system-proxy global.

local_validation.local_failure_scope: Sandbox-only AF_UNIX path length and private D-Bus tests; CI runs them and passes.

ci_validation.appcontainer_native_lab: Server 2025 product phases confined/firewall-off/revoked passed on PR #11

known_limitations: Global system proxy covers only applications that honour the system proxy; others connect directly.
If the panel crashes, the system proxy points at a stopped port until the panel is opened again or stopped.
Linux automatic system proxy supports GNOME-compatible desktops only.
Windows strong isolation is experimental; Edge/Chromium crash inside the AppContainer and uninstall does not yet remove container rules.
Global system-proxy mode has not been exercised on a real Windows or Linux desktop in CI.
